scope: Core implementation requirements. Declarations and route inventory are not numerical qualification.

packages.qualification_task: Inventory remaining admission predicates and public entry points; measure accuracy, conservation, timing, allocation, memory and cancellation on committed builds.
Conformance tests for residual, charge, derivative, noise, trial/accepted ownership and atomic restore; measure adapter overhead.
Preserve exact event clocks, accepted grids, retry/rollback and checkpoint continuation for every extraction.

Public phase execution, independent oracles, restart, fallible phase storage and fixed BJT/UIC initialization, typed allocation and per-site record-ceiling diagnostics, retained result accounting, and aggregate live/copy transport-record budgets are exercised. Accepted-work and continuation cancellation, native default/minimal test/release configurations, and repeated public-run/charged-transport measurements are exercised in core-gp-measurements-windows-20261005.json. Independent prescribed-terminal saturation/reverse-active/high-injection oracles and the rounding-sized event-remainder repair are exercised in core-gp-regimes-windows-20261005.json. The same 18 GP integration tests execute as WebAssembly in Node, a Chrome window and an optimized Chrome dedicated worker in core-gp-wasm-windows-20261006.json; native registration, strict WASM Clippy and a permanent Firefox worker CI selection are delivered. Complete remaining feedback/private-node and parameter cases, configuration coverage, whole-run memory/allocation, inner-solve cancellation and broader performance limits. Other state owners, VM transactions and full route coverage remain C01/C09/C12/C14 work. da18bfa88 adds independent bias-dependent forward/reverse charge oracles. 50523d8fb preserves small peripheral event-charge modes, with a six-node-order regression; the subsequent private high-injection convergence failures remain unresolved. Required ignored regressions private_nodes::gp_exact_delay_solves_biased_charge_through_private_terminal_resistances and static_private::gp_exact_phase_retains_a_small_reverse_charge_mode_at_private_dc_bias must pass and become active before C03c closes. C03d must supply missing physical-event device equations, starting with the behavioral-source reproducer in gp_phase_regimes/coverage_gaps.rs; its explicit refusal is not implementation completion.
Compare every command with direct execution; verify producer dependencies, alteration, nested sweeps, limits and cancellation.
Polynomial two-tone products and intercepts; unequal tones, coincidence, windows, dynamic range, noise and compression.
Public periodic residual, small-signal, shooting and envelope evidence per model/instance restriction, including conservation and independent references.
Public memory, switch, line and magnetic cases with event refinement, causal histories, conservation and continuation.
DC reduction, modulated and correlated independent oracles, sideband convergence and integrated power.
Real runtime/generated/XSPICE models through core evaluators, complete state, operator-aware admission and rollback.
Coupled equilibrium, event ordering, rejected side effects and persisted deterministic continuation.
Analog/discrete period closure, moving-event derivatives, conversion, sampled noise and envelope evidence.
Every public route retains options, identity, units, errors, limits and producer state; compare transient observation routes.
Review responsibility boundaries and duplicate numerical contracts; measure memory, sparse scaling and hot-path changes.
Requirement-by-requirement committed-build audit across profiles/features; independent corpora, boundary fuzzing and failure atomicity.
